_comment: Round 2 copy (01-ux.md 2 to 16, 04-design.md 10, 02-sounds.md credits). added: keys new this round, expected text. changed: keys whose text changed, expected text. tools/lint-copy.test.ts excuses the added keys until the screens that use them land.

added.picker.lead: We choose music in your range. Pick a card, then press play to hear it.
added.picker.play.caption: Lowest, your notes at difficulty {level}, highest.
added.picker.play.fallback: There's no {instrument} sound yet. You'll hear a {standIn}.
added.picker.play.failed: That sound didn't play. Check your volume and try again.
added.picker.sound.line: This is how it will sound. The starting pitch, Listen and Match a note use this sung “ah” in {voice} range. It's made by the app, not recorded.
added.picker.sound.line.short: This is how it will sound: a sung “ah” made by the app, in {voice} range.
added.picker.sound.instrument: This is how it will sound. The starting pitch, Listen and Match a note use this {instrument} sound.
added.match.title: Match a note
added.match.lead.voice: Listen, then sing the note. Hold it until the needle sits in the middle.
added.match.lead.instrument: Listen, then play the note. Hold it until the needle sits in the middle.
added.match.notHeard: We can't hear a steady note yet. Move a little closer to the mic and hold one note.
added.match.summary: {hit} of {total} hit. On average you were {cents} cents {direction}.
added.match.summary.centre: You were right in the middle on average.
added.match.pickNote: Or tap a note in your range to choose it.
added.match.noMic: Matching a note needs the microphone.
added.match.onboarding.hit: We heard you clearly. You're ready.
added.match.onboarding.otherVoice: Your notes sat above the {voice} range. Would {other} fit better?
added.match.hint.idle: The note plays for 1.5 seconds. The microphone opens after it.
added.match.hint.listening: The needle moves when we hear a steady note.
added.match.hint.flat: Lift it a little until the needle sits in the middle.
added.match.hint.far: Slide up slowly. The needle comes in when you are close.
added.match.hint.far.down: Slide down slowly. The needle comes in when you are close.
added.match.hint.octave: Instruments match the octave. Voices do not need to.
added.match.summary.note: Nothing is graded or saved. Practice and History are unchanged.
added.home.matchEntry.body: Sing one note and see if you hit it. Not graded.
added.home.matchEntry.body.instrument: Play one note and see if you hit it. Not graded.
added.calStatus.ok.detail: Your setup adds {ms} ms. We take it off every note, so early and late are fair.
added.calStatus.none.detail: Tries count as practice until you calibrate. It takes about {seconds} seconds.
added.calStatus.changed.detail: You calibrated for {oldOutput}. Timing for {output} isn't measured yet.
added.calStatus.failed.detail: {reason} You can try again or keep practising.
added.calStatus.readthrough.note: We'll bring you back to this music after.
added.setup.mode.blocked.calibration.link: Ranked needs calibration on this device. {link}
added.results.tries.atPiece: {n, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} at this piece
added.heard.caption: What we heard, bar {n} of {total}
added.heard.none: We didn't hear any notes in this try.
added.heard.caption.note: The notes we detected, in your instrument's sound. Not a recording.
added.heard.note: Hear what we heard plays the notes we detected, in your instrument's sound. It is not a recording.
added.history.filter.pieceLine: Showing {n} of {total} tries: the ones at {title}.
added.results.showHeard.key: The pitch we heard. A line that falls after a note is your voice trailing off: it is part of that note, not a new one.
added.setup.key.uses: Difficulty {level} uses {modes} keys with up to {n, plural, one {# sharp or flat} other {# sharps or flats}}.
added.setup.key.next.more: Keys with {n} sharps or flats start at difficulty {next}.
added.setup.key.many: {n} keys: major and minor, up to {max} sharps or flats.
added.setup.key.pick: Pick one key, or Any for more XP.
added.ranked.reason.clockRate: Your device's sound timing was uneven, so this try counts as practice.
added.error.audioStart.title: The sound didn't start
added.error.audioStart.body: Your browser didn't let the sound start. Press Try again. If it happens again, reload the page.
added.error.micStart.title: The microphone didn't open
added.error.micStart.body: Another app may be using it. Close that app, then press Try again.
added.error.kept: Your piece is kept. Try again starts it from the beginning.
added.error.diagnostics.prompt: Keeps happening? Save what the app saw for the team.
added.countIn.reference.why: So you know where to begin: the key chord, then your first note. You don't need to sing yet.
added.scan.sounds.onStart.voice: When you start: your starting pitch, then {bars, plural, one {one bar} other {# bars}} of clicks.
added.scan.sounds.onStart.instrument: When you start: {bars, plural, one {one bar} other {# bars}} of clicks.
added.scan.sounds.whenStart.voice: When you start: your starting pitch, then two bars of clicks.
added.scan.sounds.whenStart.instrument: When you start: two bars of clicks.
added.settings.practice.autoReference: Play my starting pitch before the count-in
added.settings.practice.autoReference.hint: You can always hear it on the read-through.
added.a11y.countIn.announce.bars: Count-in, {total, plural, one {one bar} other {# bars}}. Come in after the last {beats}. Press Escape to stop.
added.look.lead: Five things to spot before you start.
added.settings.data.exportDiagnostics.hint: One file with all {n} tries: notes, timings, marks and settings. No recording of your voice.
added.settings.data.diagnostics.lead: What the app heard in each try, so the team can see why a mark appeared. Kept on this device for your last 20 tries.
added.diagnostics.hint: A file of what the app heard in this try: notes, timings and settings. No recording of your voice. Send it to support if marks look wrong.
added.diagnostics.noTrack: This try is too old to include the pitch track. The notes and marks are included.
added.diagnostics.prompt: Marks look wrong? Save what the app heard for the team.
added.diagnostics.prompt.send: Marks look wrong? Send us what the app heard.
added.diagnostics.title: Save diagnostics
added.diagnostics.recentPointer: Recent tries, all in one file: Settings › Data.
added.diagnostics.body: A file of what the app heard in this try, for the Sightread team to look at. No recording of your voice.
added.diagnostics.item.notes: Every note we heard: when, how long, what pitch, how sure
added.diagnostics.item.marks: Every mark, and the ones that changed after the try
added.diagnostics.item.setup: Your settings, calibration and device, no names
added.diagnostics.keepSound: Keep the sound of my next tries for diagnostics
added.diagnostics.keepSound.hint: Off. It stays on this device and is only in a file you send.
added.settings.display.ghostsLive.hint: A wrong note always shows the note you sang, in grey. This is for extra notes (plus signs) and early or late notes, which at low difficulties wait for the results.
added.settings.display.showHeard.hint: Draws the pitch we heard as a thin line on the results. For troubleshooting.
added.sure.clear: We heard you clearly. {steady} of {total} notes were steady and clear.
added.sure.mostly: We heard most of it. {n, plural, one {# mark} other {# marks}} may be wrong.
added.sure.unsure: We weren't sure about many notes. Treat these marks as a rough guide.
added.sure.unsure.help: Move the mic away from the speakers, or use headphones, and sing a little louder.
